text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—Mmm~, smells so good! Looks like it's 
almost done, yup.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, shall I bring over the plates? Also, 
getting the sauce and mayo ready—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa whoa, hold up, stoooop! It's fine, 
it's fine, Miracle-chan. Leave this to a 
semi-pro okonomiyaki maker like me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Besides, this is supposed to be my 
thank-you for accompanying me on that 
huuuuge shopping spree the other day.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That English study guide you recommended 
to me is seriously awesome~. It's full of 
cute picture-book-like illustrations!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad if it helped... but you really 
didn't have to worry about thanking me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
There, there, don't worry about it... 
Whoops! It's gonna burn. C'mon, let's eat!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wahaha~, looks so tasty! *Blows* 
*blows*... Hot, hot, hot, hot!! C'mon 
c'mon, Mirakul-tsan too!!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah. *blows*...

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Hot, hot.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Phew~, stuffed to the brim~ ...Hmm? Is 
that a cute new shop over there?!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it really is! Looks like an ice cream 
parlor.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! ...Having something ice-cold and 
super sweet right after hot, savory food 
is... the absolute best, isn't it~...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Aah, but the calories... Still, 
thoughhh~...!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...By the way, Miracle-chan, how full is 
your tummy feeling right now~...?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Let's see... If we split one in 
half, I think I could manage.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yayyy!! Yup, yup, that way we cut down on 
calories, so it's totally perfect♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
And we're baaack. Phew, thanks for today, 
Miracle-chan!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, please. I should be the one thanking 
you. You gave me such a fun time today...

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I didn't really do anything special. I 
wonder if it's really okay for me to 
receive such a wonderful thank-you gift.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Eh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, whoa whoa whoa! A thank-you... C-Come 
to think of it, that's right, it was 
supposed to be a thank-you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Man~... Ahaha, my bad. Somewhere along the 
line, I was just normally having fun 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Just hanging out normally with you, 
Miracle-chan... Doing whatever we wanted, 
y'know?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: (...—'Whatever we wanted'?)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Uhh... ahaha. Well, that's why.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Normally speaking, it's just something I 
wanted to do, really.

One day, when I stretched my budget a bit 
to visit a luxury department store, I 
spotted KS Miracle and Daiichi Ruby 
together.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Here you are. ...I must apologize once 
again for dirtying your personal 
handkerchief the other day.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, really. You didn't have to worry about 
that— ......

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...The embroidery on this handkerchief is 
so beautiful. Is it from a shop you're 
fond of, Ruby?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I hold a deep admiration for their 
refined craftsmanship and aesthetic 
beauty.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I see. ...So it's something you truly 
like, then. ...——

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Ruby. ...I will cherish it 
dearly.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Do you use one from the same shop as well, 
Ruby? ...Could I take a look at yours next 
time?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: If it interests you, by all means.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'll cherish it... Hmm, should I keep it 
safely put away, or put it on display 
somewhere...?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...It is a handkerchief, so I believe it 
would be best if you actually used it.
